statement: Under Equation (3.3), the associated graded algebra is the following specific subalgebra of R[τ, τ−1]: G := gr A = R[τ, I/τ2 ] = R[τ, f/τ2 , g/τ2 ]. (3.5) It is a smooth domain. Give P = C[p, s, u, F, J] the presentation weights (ω(p), ω(s), ω(u), ω(F), ω(J)) = (−1, 0, 0, 2, 2). (3.6) Then every nonzero h ∈ A has a polynomial representative whose maximum weight is exactly deg h, and there is a graded isomorphism G ∼ = P/(Htop), Htop = x2 F − (1 + 2sx)J − p2 J2 , x = s2 + u3 + p2 F. (3.7) The images of p, s, u, F, J in this isomorphism are respectively τ, sR, u, f/τ2, g/τ2.
